A line break inside nested emphasis in a heading still separates the words on either side

```r title="R"
library("htmltomarkdown", character.only = TRUE)

result <- convert(html = "<h2><strong>Alpha</strong><strong><em><br></em></strong>Beta</h2>", options = ConversionOptions$default())
print(result$content)
```
